title: KAN: Kolmogorov–Arnold Networks

layout.note: A ruled table of a narrow row-header column and two wide columns, MLP left and KAN right, over six rows: headers, theorem, shallow formula, shallow drawings (a) and (b), deep formula, deep drawings (c) and (d). Each MLP cell sits level with its KAN counterpart.

lesson: Compare two architectures in a ruled table with row headers for theorem, formula and drawing, and draw both networks on the same skeleton so the one difference (activation glyphs on edges instead of nodes) stands out, with italic call-outs naming it.
